children: Citigroup veteran Vitaly Vaganov has joined First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB) as Managing Director and Co-Head of M&A Advisory.
Vaganov most recently worked in Citigroup’s London-based EMEA Energy Investment Banking team.
In his new role at FAB, he will focus on the origination and execution of M&A transactions across the energy and natural resources sectors.
Vaganov will be reporting to Tom Emmet, Managing Director, Head of Global M&A Advisory and ECM, Global Corporate Finance at FAB.
(Reporting by Seban Scaria; editing by Daniel Luiz)

title: Citi veteran joins FAB as MD and Co-Head of M&A Advisory
